contract: For the preregistered selection seed, run vanilla ASGD at all nine paper learning rates and Clipped ASGD at all nine learning rates crossed with four clipping radii, using real label-skew CIFAR-10, Algorithm 2, and the exact 12,000-time-unit D=8 cap.
selection_rule: Within each method, select the smallest first 70%-accuracy hit time. A run without a hit is censored at the paper cap and cannot win.
non_circularity: No configuration is pruned and the event budget comes from the paper, not an observed or predicted result.
negative_control: The initialized model must remain below 70%.
terminal_claim_verdict: BLOCKED pending independent three-seed winner repeats.
